title: 财长罕见自曝：菲律宾FDI数据，失真
speaker: Ralph Recto

segments.en: Well first, our investment registration approvals in 2024 and in 2025 both hit 1.9 trillion pesos. These are both record numbers in the Philippines, per year, 1.9 trillion pesos per year in 2024 and 2025.
segments.zh: 首先，2024年和2025年我们的注册审批额均达到1.9万亿比索，连续两年创下历史纪录。

segments.en: Now to go to FDIs per se, when I joined government I actually realized something. There was something wrong with our FDI numbers. So I actually went and took a look at it and I said, what is the basis of the FDI data?
segments.zh: 至于FDI本身，我加入政府后发现我们的FDI数据存在问题。我仔细核查后问：FDI数据的依据是什么？

segments.en: And the source of that data is simply one source. If money goes through the banking system, and when you take the box you check for investments, that's FDI, and that's the only category tracked as FDI. So it's a very strict definition.
segments.zh: 数据来源单一：只有通过银行系统、并勾选“投资”选项的资金才被计入FDI，这是非常严格的定义。

segments.en: So very recently, our Philippine Statistics Authority, the Bangko Central ng Pilipinas, and the Securities and Exchange Commission signed a joint memorandum agreement for them to data share, so that we can really capture the real FDI in the Philippines today.
segments.zh: 因此，最近菲律宾统计局、央行和证券交易委员会签署了数据共享协议，以便真实捕捉当前的FDI流入。

segments.en: In today's day and age, nobody really sends money across borders anymore with so much anti-money laundering rules. Most investors now send in kind. For example, if somebody's putting up a one billion dollar offshore wind project in the Philippines, you don't send one billion dollars to the Philippines and start buying stuff all over the world.
segments.zh: 如今，在严格的反洗钱规则下，很少有人跨境汇款。多数投资者以实物出资。例如，若有人要在菲律宾建设10亿美元的海上风电项目，他不会汇10亿美元过来再采购，而是直接运来设备。

segments.en: You actually send the windmill, the equipment into the Philippines as your FDI, and that does not get captured. So for me, what I'd rather take a look at is the investment registration agreements, and how much of those really become investments.
segments.zh: 这些设备作为FDI进入菲律宾，却未被统计。因此我更关注注册审批协议，以及其中有多少真正转化为实际投入。
